2. Registering the ended identity again answers a session with no project.
   Shows A11-2. [witness: verification:registry_a11_reregistered_ended_identity_empty]
statements:
```text
end(x) accepted => not registered(x) and no record of x remains   -- A11-1
register(x) after end(x) => granted(x) = {} and active(x) = none   -- A11-2
```

verdicts.item:
2. Registering the ended identity again answers a session with no project.
   Shows A11-2. [witness: verification:registry_a11_reregistered_ended_identity_empty]
statements:
```text
end(x) accepted => not registered(x) and no record of x remains   -- A11-1
register(x) after end(x) => granted(x) = {} and active(x) = none   -- A11-2
```
verdicts.why: The check asserts A11-2: re-registering the ended identity creates a new session with an empty granted-project set and no active project. It does not assert A11-1 as stated because it never checks, between ending and re-registration, that the identity is unregistered and that no record remains.
